slot_change_request.contract: S81 HOST conditional boot300 clock grant minus the two ck_ingest pins
slot_change_request.why: Same outline and every other pin rectangle; ck_ingest[1:0] removed (one 1.2 GHz root). Conditional grant, no inherited physical view.

structural_change: ONECLK (S-ELEM-PQ/HOST 10-16, VIS-ROM S81H-01). Measured n1 cause: 4 interleaved strip-wide roots ck 4957 / ck_ingest[0] 9435 / ck_ingest[1] 9609 / ckv 125 sinks; every cross-root pair negative (hold -50..-116 ps, setup core->serial -175, host->ingest_core -353 ps), boundary spread 95-98 ps, 49,457-buffer hold flood; n5c/n6 PHASESAFE lockup-latch seams plateaued at -72.9/-93.5 ps on rd_gray_w1. Fix: the native ingest host/core clocks ARE the stream clock (same PLL, divider 3): one 1.2 GHz root for all ~24k stream sinks; every ingest FIFO is a same-root crossing; no lockup latches anywhere (PHASESAFE off); the only other roots are ck_boot (300 MHz = ck/4, initialization FIFOs) and ckv (900 MHz serial outputs), whose crossings ck->ck_boot->ckv each get a full fast-clock period (all slow edges coincide with fast edges) and a coincident-edge hold check on a few hundred flop-to-flop endpoints. Address arithmetic: OT_S81_HOST_ADDR_PREFIX nibble-prefix adders (Codex 8902d55ca) plus local*pitch and sb*0x880 formed one stage earlier (A1) and stage B = one carry-save row + one prefix add (27-level ap1_pitch->ap_raddr ~952 ps; 35-level st_sec ripple -210 ps). Cost: 0 added cycles on the native path (exact 59,989-edge IKEY / ROWS calendars vs legacy PHASESAFE build), boot words 2 ckv edges earlier than legacy, boot300 init prefix 64 edges (Codex, +40 ns cold init only), +32 FF (ap1_lp/ap1_sbm). >15k sinks on ck: clock rule needs measured insertion <=300 / spread <=80 ps from the --cts gate. | o1 gate (f53bb69a3, WARN 0 fail): one ck root 23,501 sinks TT insertion 249.7..288.4 / spread 38.7 ps (clock rule by evidence), FF hold repaired to +30 ps; TT placement diagnostic reg->reg -161.9 ps st_ph -> u_ox.mem (20 levels: key/scale address = base + st_ph) and in->reg -231.3 ps (raw rst fanning into the fence async pins). o2 fixes: stage B also registers base+1 (ap_kcode1/ap_kscal1, +64 FF, SAT-proved, 0 cycles) so st_ph only selects; ingest reset = the ck-conditioned rn (raw rst reaches only the four reset synchronisers). | o2 gate 4724e76ed (AGI 075946, recovered by staged remeasurement on the original CTS DB): ck 23,842 sinks TT insertion 255.7..287.8 / spread 32.1 (clock rule by evidence PASS), FF hold repaired to +30 (36.3k hold buffers, converged), TT placement diag reg->reg -161.6 (st_sec -> host_rows_addr -> u_ox.mem[*][287], 21 levels) and in->reg recovery -207.4 (raw rst/rsv through 457 ps IO budget into the OTHER root's pw_wrs/pw_rrs synchronizer inside a 278 ps 4:3 window). o3: ROWS address registered as ap_rcur (= u_raddr+st_sec, loaded on !ap_ok, +1 on the st_sec+1 edges); pw_wrs/pw_rrs async input rn&&rvn (assert async from own port, release launched by own-root flops). Exact gate PASS (ikey/rows 59,989 edges, boot 8 phases) + rows_rcur stride mutant FAIL.

job.purpose: One 1.2 GHz root HOST (no ck_ingest roots, no lockup latches), boot300 full-period crossings, pipelined address arithmetic; exact native calendar unchanged.

reroute_reason.why_route: Clocking structure change: OT_S81_HOST_ONECLK folds the ck_ingest[1:0] host/ingest-core roots onto the stream clock ck (one 1.2 GHz root, no lockup latches), keeps only boot300 full-period crossings to ck_boot/ckv; address arithmetic pipelined (A1 product/sbm precompute, carry-save + prefix add). Distinct RTL/ABI (ck_ingest ports removed) from every earlier dsfd_host_c view.

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every data pin on its declared root: inputs fi (f_collective), hc_q (hc), ss1 (f_sseq_st), wf (f_wfc_ft), lf_pins (f_lf); outputs to (t_collective), hw, t_sseq_pw / t_pq_pw / t_sseq_plen (ckv). A generic single-clock wrapper would mis-clock the ckv outputs and add a duplicate stage.
